# Axes

ax.set_ylabel('FPR (%)')
ax.set_xticks([0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 50])
ax.set_xlim(-2, 53)
ax.set_ylim(-3, 72)

# Spines

ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
